latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Easy — Edit and Export Polished Videos.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos (up to 500MB) for quick AI-assisted editing.
- Simple prompts like "trim the footage, add transitions, and export a clean final cut" to automate editing.
- 1080p MP4 exports optimized for fast downloads.
- Streamlined session management with automatic free token creation if needed.
- Easily check credits, status, and manage exports through clear chat commands.
